stocks.title: VIX spikes as Wall Street slides into extreme fear
stocks.detail: The VIX jumped over 30% intraday Friday and Fear and Greed readings sat around 18 to 25. CoreWeave fell over 12% on debt worries. Traders are split on whether this is a washout bottom or just the start.

stocks.title: Bank stocks log six straight down weeks, longest since 2008
stocks.detail: The KBW Bank Index is about 13% off its August peak, with BofA, Wells, Goldman and Morgan Stanley each down over 20% from highs. High rates and deposit costs are the drag; earnings did not help.

stocks.title: SpaceX reports Monday, a day before Tesla, fueling merger talk
stocks.detail: SpaceX posts Q3 results after the close Oct 20. Barclays floated an all-stock SpaceX-Tesla merger idea and Kalshi shows about 60% odds of a deal before May 2027. Expect TSLA chatter all weekend.

stocks.title: Schwab opens Bitcoin and Ether trading to retail clients
stocks.detail: Schwab Crypto is now live for eligible US accounts with a 0.75% fee, Solana planned later. Bitcoin is holding near 81K after dipping under 80K; traders want a weekly close above 82K.

tech.title: Anthropic staff expect Nobel-level AI science by 2027
tech.detail: Internal surveys shared by chief economist Peter McCrory show 91% of employees expect AI-driven Nobel-level breakthroughs by 2030, versus 39% of US adults. Staff see AI doing 75% of their work hours by 2030.

tech.title: Linus Torvalds vibe-codes a tool with Google's Antigravity
tech.detail: Torvalds merged an AI-generated Python visualizer into his AudioNoise hobby project, keeping the core C by hand. It reignited the debate over speed versus maintainability of AI-written code.

tech.title: OpenAI dots are handling 3 AM on-call pages
tech.detail: OpenAI's always-on agents triage incidents, draft pull requests and monitor channels. One engineer handled a page from bed through the ChatGPT app; teams cite over 1,400 merged PRs.

tech.title: Nvidia's ASPIRE robot solves a Rubik's Cube with two arms
tech.detail: Nvidia's GEAR lab open-sourced ASPIRE v1.0, a framework that lets robots learn, debug and improve from real-world feedback. Demos include the cube solve, screwing bottle caps and stacking cups.

world.title: Norte Fire hits 465 acres with zero containment
world.detail: Santa Ana winds pushed the San Clemente fire through neighborhoods, destroying homes. Evacuations cover San Clemente and San Juan Capistrano zones, with other fires burning at Camp Pendleton and Malibu.

world.title: Iran's president says Tehran wants no nuclear weapons
world.detail: Pezeshkian told Georgia's prime minister Iran is open to talks without pressure. Traders see possible oil relief but doubt the timing, with Iran's forces still on high alert near Hormuz.

world.title: Indonesia stocks crash 11% on an MSCI downgrade threat
world.detail: The Jakarta index had its worst day in nearly three decades after MSCI opened a review on moving Indonesia out of emerging markets over ownership transparency. The market is down nearly 40% this year.

world.title: FIFA reviews its Trump Peace Prize after one year
world.detail: FIFA's council asked its social responsibility committee to decide whether to keep, change or scrap the prize, with some members wanting politicians excluded. A report is due in Doha in December.

gbot.say: Luka and a brand-new starting five vs Denver right now. Then SpaceX reports Monday, TSLA Wednesday. Buckle up, Kent.
